item.title: Sinaloa participates for the second time in the Gulfood Dubai Expo
item.description: For the second consecutive year, the state of Sinaloa is participating in Expo Gulfood Dubai 2026, with the goal of strengthening the presence of Sinaloa chickpeas in the Middle Eastern market. This year, a delegation of producers and distributors from the state aims to sell approximately 70,000 tons of the grain. item.title: The court invalidates the punishment for the crime of “halconeo” in Sinaloa
item.description: The Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation (SCJN) declared the crime of “halconeo” (acting as a lookout for criminal organizations) unconstitutional on Monday. This crime, defined in the Sinaloa Penal Code, resulted from a reform that took effect last year amidst the ongoing war between factions of the Sinaloa Cartel.
